```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(fontawesome)

# Base URLs & Colors
slides_repo <- "https://stats6-sp26.github.io/slides/"
gradescope  <- "https://www.gradescope.com/courses/1287917"
crimson     <- "#A51C30"

# 1. Map column context + file extension/keyword to FontAwesome icons
get_icon_name <- function(item, col_type) {
  case_when(
    grepl("quiz", item)                   ~ "circle-question", 
    col_type == "prepare"                 ~ "book",            
    grepl("\\.R$", item)                  ~ "r-project",      
    col_type == "lecture"                 ~ "display",        
    col_type == "section"                 ~ "repeat",          
    col_type == "homework"                ~ "list-check",  
    col_type == "exams"                   ~ "pen-to-square",         
    col_type == "project"                 ~ "people-group",          
    TRUE                                  ~ "link"
  )
}

# 2. Helper to build HTML links according to URL routing rules
format_links <- function(items_str, column_type) {
  if (is.na(items_str) || str_trim(items_str) == "") return("")
  
  items <- str_split(items_str, "\\s*,\\s*")[[1]]
  
  links <- map_chr(items, function(item) {
    if (is.na(item) || item == "") return("")
    
    icon_name <- get_icon_name(item, column_type)
    
    url <- case_when(
      grepl("^http", item)             ~ item,
      # Quizzes go to Gradescope
      grepl("quiz", item)              ~ paste0(gradescope, "/assignments/", item),
      # Lecture files go to slides repo
      column_type == "lecture"        ~ paste0(slides_repo, item),
      # Readings, section, homework, exams, project go to HTML files in specific-content/<type>/
      column_type == "prepare"        ~ paste0("specific-content/readings/", item),
      column_type == "section"        ~ paste0("specific-content/sections/", item),
      column_type == "homework"       ~ paste0("specific-content/homework/", item),
      column_type == "exams"          ~ paste0("specific-content/exams/", item),
      column_type == "project"        ~ paste0("specific-content/project/", item),
      TRUE                            ~ paste0("specific-content/", column_type, "/", item)
    )
    
    paste0(
      '<a href="', url, '" style="color: ', crimson, '; text-decoration: none;" aria-label="', item, '">',
      fa(icon_name, fill = crimson), 
      '</a>'
    )
  })
  
  str_flatten(links[links != ""], collapse = '<span style="margin-right: 6px;"></span>')
}

# 3. Legend matching your exact function icon mappings
legend_df <- tibble(
  `Icon` = c(
    as.character(fa("book", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("circle-question", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("display", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("r-project", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("repeat", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("list-check", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("pen-to-square", fill = crimson)),
    as.character(fa("people-group", fill = crimson))
  ),
  `Meaning` = c("Reading", "Quiz", "Slides", "R Code", "Section", "Homework", "Exams", "Project")
)

legend_html <- legend_df |> 
  mutate(item = paste0('<span style="margin-right: 14px; white-space: nowrap;">', Icon, ' ', Meaning, '</span>')) |> 
  pull(item) |> 
  str_flatten(collapse = "") |> 
  (\(x) paste0('<div style="font-size: 0.85em; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 8px; background-color: #F8FAFC; border-radius: 4px;">', x, '</div>'))()

# 4. Read & process schedule data
schedule_data <- read_csv(here::here("specific-content/schedule-template.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    date = as.character(date), # Replaced ymd() with simple character conversion
    across(c(prepare, lecture, section, homework, exams, project), 
           ~ map2_chr(.x, cur_column(), format_links))
  )

# 5. Identify end-of-week rows for borders
end_of_week_rows <- schedule_data |> 
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |> 
  group_by(week) |> 
  filter(row_id == max(row_id)) |> 
  pull(row_id)

# 6. Render GT Table
schedule_data |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = html(legend_html)) |> 
  cols_label(
    week     = "Week",
    day      = "Day",
    date     = "Date",
    topic    = "Topic",
    prepare  = "Prepare",
    lecture  = "Lecture",
    section  = "Section",
    homework = "Homework",
    exams    = "Exams",
    project  = "Project"
  ) |> 
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(prepare, lecture, section, homework, exams, project)) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "#94A3B8", weight = px(1.5)),
    locations = cells_body(rows = end_of_week_rows)
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "none",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = crimson,
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table_body.hlines.color = "#F1F5F9",
    table_body.vlines.color = "#E2E8F0",
    table_body.vlines.style = "solid",
    column_labels.vlines.color = "#CBD5E1",
    column_labels.vlines.style = "solid"
  ) |> 
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(week, day, date, prepare, lecture, section, homework, exams, project)) |> 
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = topic)
```
